text:
Alyssa: quick design check — thresholds panel update. UX asks: should units be inline (dropdown) or a small toggle that switches between short/long form? examples: `5m` vs `per 5 minutes`. Also suppression preview overlaps the channel pills at narrow widths. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/suppression-overlap.png

Ben: +1 on the units toggle. short form looks cleaner in compact rows. but accessibility-wise we need the long label available to screen readers. maybe: visual `5m` + `aria-label='over 5 minutes'`.

Jamie: Agree with Ben. Also noticed the preview header says "Preview (3 channels)" — confusing when user mutes a channel. Could be "Preview (3 channels — 1 muted)" or greyed pill state.

Samir: Copy nit: the threshold helper currently reads `when error rate > 2%`. Suggest `when error rate exceeds 2% over 5 minutes` so timeframe isn't ambiguous.

Maya: A11y nit: keyboard focus order jumps from the threshold input to the save button, skipping the suppression toggle. Can repro with VoiceOver. We should ensure logical tab order and visible focus ring for pills.

Ben: Mock adjustments: 1) unit toggle component to the right of numeric input (tiny toggle `short | long`). 2) suppressed channel rows collapse into a subtle list below preview with a chevron. 3) add microcopy under threshold input: `Compared to previous 5m window` (linkable to docs).

Alyssa: design-bot posted updated frame 3 mins ago: https://figma.redwood.in/frames/alerting/v3 — please review contrast for muted pill (current #666 on #fff fails AA).

design-bot: Automated contrast check: muted-pill label fails contrast (ratio 3.8). Recommended contrast color: #4A4A4A or increase weight.

Jamie: For the compact mobile layout: instead of a horizontal pill overflow, use a stacked collapsible list under "Preview" with "Show more". Horizontal scroll is meh for screen readers.

Samir: UX edge case: when a policy routes to a fallback model/channel we should show that in the preview and indicate latency-based routing. e.g. `Primary: PagerDuty (fast), Fallback: Email (on error)`. Right now preview hides fallback.

Maya: Also propose a aria-live region for the preview when someone toggles suppression so assistive tech announces changes: `Suppression enabled — 2 channels muted`.

Alyssa: action items: Ben to update mocks with unit toggle + aria-label approach, Jamie to provide mobile stacked preview pattern, Samir to add fallback visibility spec, Maya to write a11y acceptance criteria, I'll update copy suggestions in the figma comments. Target: next UX sync (Thursday). :eyes: 

Ben: noted, will post updated frames by EOD Wednesday.

Alyssa: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
